designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home National Monument in Jackson, Mississippi, in the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act.

sources.name: NPS, Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home Laws & Policies

designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of the Interior established Medgar and Myrlie Evers Home National Monument after Tougaloo College conveyed the family home to the National Park Service.

authority.citation: Secretarial decision memorandum (Nov. 9, 2020); notice of establishment, 85 FR 78354 (Dec. 4, 2020)

designationHistory.note: Interior publicly announced the establishment on Dec. 10, 2020; the decision memorandum that established the monument is dated Nov. 9, 2020. The home was conveyed June 18, 2020.

sources.name: Federal Register notice of establishment, 85 FR 78354 (govinfo)
